title: The U.S. Is Terrorizing Cuba to Make Rich Men Richer
summary: A political analysis article from Current Affairs arguing that U.S. policies toward Cuba—including the embargo and recent decisions to reinstate Cuba on the terrorism sponsors list—serve economic interests of wealthy elites rather than stated goals of democracy promotion or human rights. The article analyzes the historical context and current political dynamics of U.S.-Cuba relations.
problem_solved: This is a political opinion piece, not a technical solution; it addresses perceived injustice in U.S. foreign policy toward Cuba.
why_valuable: Provides critical perspective on the economic motivations behind U.S. Cuba policy and challenges mainstream narratives about American foreign policy objectives.
